news.summary: Crown Castle rose 10.08% and Bloom Energy fell 10.71% among S&P 500 top movers, with Palo Alto Networks, SLB, AT&T and T-Mobile also posting notable moves.

news.headline: Agent cloud startup Daytona hits $1B valuation backed by FirstMark and a who’s who of angels
news.summary: Daytona is building a cloud for agents that's like giving every agent its own computer. It has attracted founders of Stripe, Perplextity, Datadog, Mercor, and others as angels, it says.

news.headline: Datadog Soars 5% as BofA Lifts Price Target to $335 Ahead of Q3 Earnings
news.summary: Key TakeawaysDatadog shares rose 5% today after BofA raised its price target to $335 from $305 and kept its Buy rating. The rise follows Thursday’s 4% drop, which came after a report that Datadog had offered nearly $4 billion for cloud security startup Upwind.
